findings.path: openspec/changes/afk-live-financial-execution/specs/afk-live-accounting/spec.md#Authenticated MC02 envelope on the preserved MC01 master
findings.finding: The parameterized contract resolves R05-A1: campaign binding authenticates amendment, projection and both votes; retained predecessor bytes fix historical attribution; MC01 ordinary rows/planning/overhead/package counters remain unchanged; MC02 current-envelope debits remain external rows. G/N, C/D, reserve transfer, S/n recomputation, aggregate counter changes and reader owner-mode selection are deterministic. A concrete live grant is still absent, but no invented live value is needed to implement a positive fixture.
findings.expectedOutcome: Reject omitted/modified predecessor rows, wrong owner/action/context, duplicate application, unapproved D/deficit, reserve-transfer mismatch and S/n counter tampering through actual producer and reader. Preserve legacy profile behavior.

findings.path: openspec/changes/afk-live-financial-execution/specs/afk-live-accounting/spec.md#Authenticated context discovery and closed evidence payloads
findings.finding: The closed immutable context gives the actual CLI an authenticated discovery route for canonical store identity/inventory, exact retained history/event mapping, observer entry/destinations and current correspondence. Current evidence lives outside frozen source/binding/runner inputs, so a successful observation and subsequent reservation do not require rehashing their debit authority. Missing identity cannot trigger adoption, and arbitrary caller-written funding receipts cannot satisfy final correspondence.
findings.expectedOutcome: Exercise real cmd_run discovery and the actual history reader on a positively anchored fixture. Falsify each contained reference/digest/identity/event mapping and reject same-token rollback/clone replay at the durable master claim. Preflight-only and final correspondence phases must be distinguished, with final non-null runtime/reservation IDs required before launch.

findings.finding: The explicit exception removes the funding-before-funding cycle without free observation work: the reviewed G/N includes one 125-second observer operation, charged before its child, with its own master claim. Its failure consumes S/n but does not consume loan attempt 3. The held exclusive wallet lock and exact handoff constrain intervening wallet use. The one-attempt rule prohibits silently refreshing expired evidence for free.
findings.expectedOutcome: Test real preflight invocation order, one-shot failure/timeout consumption, forbidden free retry, lock competition and same-owner handoff. Only successful retained bounded observer execution may produce usable correspondence; financial debit follows valid funding. A failed observer leaves runtime charge absent.

findings.path: openspec/changes/afk-live-financial-execution/specs/afk-live-accounting/spec.md#Single allocation, all-kind limits and prepaid boundary
findings.finding: The exact own-prepaid exception handles S=G and n=N without subtracting c twice or demanding a second unreserved master allowance. The post-reservation recheck recognizes only its own matching reservation while the master launch claim remains unclaimed. All other invocations see exhausted bounds. This requires changes to the current reader and actual CLI, whose inspected pre-repair ordering checks final snapshot before any producer.
findings.expectedOutcome: Demonstrate one final prepaid launch and no replay through actual producer/CLI/reader/store with a stubbed final child. Independently test competing final debits, changed source/runner, conflicting reservations and each cross-file/SQLite/master crash point; consumed costs never reset.

findings.finding: The observer has concrete child-wallet restore/start/sync/stop interfaces, original identity checks, exact available-token and generatedNow DUST computation, independent retained pending-use reconciliation, 120-second freshness and bounded cleanup. Its callable source can be implemented and tested independently; neither restore-empty pending state nor historical finality alone establishes current spendable funds.
findings.expectedOutcome: Test the real callable observer with isolated seed/snapshots and controlled pinned SDK transports, immutable canonical fixture inputs and forbidden API/write traps. Reject partial initialization cleanup failure, future/stale timestamps, wrong identity/units, unresolved material prior use or arbitrary public receipts.

findings.finding: Source acceptance must include the specified actual submission-reservation consumer, not only Python counters. The existing runner has exact debit and bounded execution checks that must survive factoring; providers binding/reservation logic must bind the same invocation and enforce every actual SDK submission/retry. Current policy/store bytes are pre-repair context and receive no acceptance from this review.
findings.expectedOutcome: Keep four submission calls distinct from the third loan-case attempt and from the separately charged observer. Final executor/source closure, concrete financial units and ceilings, exact live history adoption and resource votes remain separately required.
